resources.string: The bot is joining
This usually takes less than a minute.
Let the bot in
The bot is waiting to be let in. In your meeting, admit Meeting Mind (or the bot name you chose). It gives up after 10 minutes.
Almost ready
The bot is in the meeting and not recording yet. If your meeting asks whether it may record, allow it.
The bot did not record this meeting
Nobody let the bot in from the waiting room in time. Join again and admit it when it asks.
The bot was removed from the waiting room. Ask the host to let it in, then join again.
The meeting had not started. Start the meeting, then join again.
The meeting passcode was wrong or missing. Paste the full invite link, with the passcode, and join again.
The meeting was not found. Check the link and join again.
This meeting only admits signed-in or registered people. Ask the host to allow guests, then join again.
The meeting did not allow the bot to join. Ask the host to allow it, then join again.
Recording was not allowed. Ask the host to allow recording, then join again.
The bot could not join. Check the meeting link and join again.
Starting AI Coach…
Tips appear about every 30 seconds once the bot is in the meeting and people are talking.
Reconnecting…
Stop
AI Coach has ended.
AI Coach stopped because the bot was not let into the meeting.
AI Coach stopped because the bot could not join the meeting.
AI Coach ended without hearing any speech.
AI Coach could not create tips because of a problem on our side.
Your session credit was returned.
No credit was used.
AI Coach did not start because you have no sessions left.
AI Coach did not start because the bot is no longer in the meeting.
AI Coach could not start. Check your connection and try again.
Tips appear in this app, on the meeting\'s Transcript tab. Admit the bot when it asks to join.
In this language the live transcript arrives minutes late, so tips will be late too.
